provenance.method: Steam developer/publisher listing checked on 2026-09-02. Governed wording records collecting, arranging, storage/sale and idle-background mechanics; storefront 'Relaxing'/'Cozy' tags and review language are not treated as evidence of personal fit or wellbeing effect.

name: Garden Galaxy
description: A single-player garden-building and organising sandbox where randomised item drops can be collected, arranged, stored or sold, with visitors continuing to arrive while the game is idle in the background.
intended_use: Inspect when looking for collecting, arranging, organising and creative garden-building mechanics, including a background-idle loop.
audience_or_context: General-audience players browsing by mechanics rather than diagnosis; this listing does not claim that the game is calming, therapeutic or suitable for a neurodivergent person.
limitations: Randomised item drops can create collection or completion pressure for some players even though the presentation is marketed as relaxing.
An idle/background loop may distract rather than help some users and is not presented as an attention-regulation aid.
The current record does not establish a complete accessibility-settings, remapping or sensory-control inventory.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial PC game distributed through Steam; price and platform requirements can change.
conflicts_of_interest: The Steam store description is developer-supplied commercial product information; ND Oracle records bounded mechanics and explicitly does not adopt storefront tags or review claims as outcome evidence.
